name: gemini-adc-dictation
title: Gemini ADC Dictation
description: Record, transcribe, and paste with Gemini on Vertex AI using Application Default Credentials.
author: rockwood

commands.name: toggle-dictation
commands.title: Toggle Gemini Dictation
commands.description: Start recording, or stop and transcribe into the app you’re using.

commands.name: cancel-dictation
commands.title: Cancel Gemini Dictation
commands.description: Stop recording and discard the current audio.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Gemini Transcription History
commands.description: Copy transcripts or retry a failed recording.

commands.name: transcribe-file
commands.title: Transcribe Audio File with Gemini
commands.description: Select an audio file and copy its transcript.

commands.name: check-setup
commands.title: Check Gemini ADC Setup
commands.description: Check credentials and model access by transcribing a bundled synthetic speech clip.

preferences.name: project
preferences.title: Google Cloud Project
preferences.description: Leave blank to use GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, the ADC quota project, or your gcloud default project.

preferences.name: location
preferences.title: Vertex AI Location
preferences.description: Use global or a supported regional endpoint.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Gemini Transcription Model
preferences.description: Defaults to the verified 3.5 specialist preview. Use gemini-3.5-transcribe for GA when your project has access. No automatic fallback.

preferences.name: credentialsFile
preferences.title: ADC File (Optional)
preferences.description: Only needed if credentials are outside the normal gcloud ADC location. Credentials stay on this Mac.

preferences.name: style
preferences.title: Transcription Style
preferences.description: Clean dictation removes fillers and spoken self-corrections; verbatim preserves spoken words.

preferences.name: vocabulary
preferences.title: Custom Vocabulary
preferences.description: Names and terms to spell correctly, separated by commas.

preferences.name: autoPaste
preferences.title: Insertion
preferences.label: Automatically paste when transcription finishes
preferences.description: Pastes into the app active when you stop dictation. If you switch apps during transcription, it copies instead. Raycast needs Accessibility permission.

preferences.name: maxSeconds
preferences.title: Recording Limit (Seconds)
preferences.description: Recording stops automatically after this limit; run Toggle again to transcribe. Between 5 and 300 seconds.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && ray build -e dist
